description: Create a new master spread. Its full name is namePrefix + "-" + baseName (e.g. "B-Chapter").

name.description: Master name; used as the base name unless baseName is given

namePrefix.description: Prefix shown on pages using this master (e.g. "B"); InDesign assigns one if omitted

pageColor.description: Pages-panel color: UI color name (e.g. "BLUE", "LIGHT_BLUE", "GRID_GREEN") or "r,g,b" (0-255), "USE_MASTER_COLOR" or "NOTHING"

pagesPerSpread.description: Pages in the master spread (default: document setting)

showMasterItems.description: Show master items on document pages

name: create_master_spread
title: Create Master Spread
